answer: Sybil defense is a stake scaling with identity count. Each key escrows a stake before work counts, so cloning it into a thousand identities costs a thousand stakes and one extra voice costs the full bond. Faked turnout needs capital locked proportional to influence, idle and slashable. Rewards settle only after attestation, so fresh keys voting in a loop earn nothing and false claims burn stake. Honest users pay one stake and get it back; attacker cost grows with attack size. In a lagoon of shallow channels only deep accounts get paid, and no marble or sparrow fakes weight by copying itself.
